name: biological_terms
description: Retrieve cell and molecular biology concepts from qualitative definitions, with matched term-copy controls.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
pairs=[('the basic structural and functional unit of living organisms','cell'),('a segment of DNA that encodes a functional product','gene'),('the molecule that stores hereditary information','DNA'),('the nucleic acid containing ribose and uracil','RNA'),('a polymer made of amino acids','protein'),('a biological catalyst','enzyme'),('the organelle where proteins are synthesized','ribosome'),('the organelle that contains most of a eukaryotic cell DNA','nucleus'),('the organelle responsible for photosynthesis','chloroplast'),('the process by which plants convert light into chemical energy','photosynthesis'),('the division that produces genetically identical daughter cells','mitosis'),('the division that produces reproductive cells with reduced chromosome sets','meiosis'),('a change in the DNA sequence','mutation'),('a structure made of DNA and proteins that carries genes','chromosome'),('the synthesis of RNA using a DNA template','transcription'),('the synthesis of protein using an RNA template','translation'),('the diffusion of water through a selectively permeable membrane','osmosis'),('a protein that specifically binds an antigen','antibody'),('a pathogen that requires a host cell to replicate','virus'),('the complete set of genetic material in an organism','genome')]
items=[];control=[]
for r in range(4):
 for desc,term in pairs:
  p=[f'Biology glossary. Definition: {desc}. Term:',f'The biological term for {desc} is',f'Name the biology concept: {desc}. Answer:',f'In biology, {desc} is called'][r]
  items.append({'prompt':p,'answer':' '+term});control.append({'prompt':f'Copy the biology term. Definition: {desc}. Term: {term}. Copied term:','answer':' '+term})
random.shuffle(items);random.shuffle(control)
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
